title: Recruit soldiers
summary: Pay men who remember the exile, or their sons, to walk with the few who already do. Coin can start a company. It cannot yet start an army.

title: Pay for more spears
summary: The northern host is already yours. Coin makes the Reach send the next company sooner, and those men will eat with the rest.

title: Hire more of the Guard
summary: Caerlyn will sell the queen more spears. Dozens, not thousands. The north is not for sale.

title: Ask the vale for riders
summary: These are Tomas's people. They will ride only if the house believes the risk is yours to take.

title: Buy food
summary: Buy food for the people who eat because of you. A few riders, a household, or a host: hunger is the same size as the company.

title: Raise taxes
summary: The lands you hold can be squeezed. The people who live on them will know whose hand did it.

title: Ease the tax
summary: A week of mercy on lands that already pay you. The ledgers will call it weakness or wisdom, depending on the year.

title: Spread your name
summary: Pay criers, priests, and liars who prefer to be called messengers.

title: Spread your name
summary: You are Ethan Valen in the open now. Pay the road to say so, accusation and all.

title: Host a feast
summary: Lords eat at a table you control, and rent you an evening of courtesy.

title: Drill the host
summary: Fewer men will run if they have practised not running. This is for a company that already exists.

title: Address the troops
summary: Stand where a real host can see your face. A handful of riders does not need a speech. An army does.

title: Hold a public audience
summary: Let the people of a land you hold bring their small disasters. Some of them will leave believing you listened.

title: Seek the Flame
summary: Ask Father Aldren, carefully, what a coronation would require of your soul.

title: Seek the Flame
summary: You are Ethan Valen again, in the open. Ask Father Aldren what a coronation would require of a man the court already condemned.

title: Seek the Flame
summary: The blood is no longer only a letter. Ask Father Aldren whether a stable-born claim can be blessed without becoming a joke.

title: Bribe a clerk
summary: The realm is indexed by people who are underpaid.

title: Offer Veyne a compact
summary: Lower a tariff you have the power to lower. Celene understands this language, and she does not bargain with men who hold no ports and no seal.

title: Hire mercenaries
summary: The White Company does not care who Erol was. They care that you already have a following, and that you pay.

title: Wait and listen
summary: Spend the week on other people's words. Sometimes that is the whole strategy.

effects.text: You let the week speak before you do.

title: Search Erol's chambers
summary: You already hold the keys. The question is which paper you are willing to find.

title: Seal the royal records
summary: Lock the archive. Lucan will object in a tone reserved for disasters.

effects.text: The royal archive is shut. Curiosity becomes a profession.

title: Summon the Chancellor
summary: Make Lucan Rook say, in front of you, what the law will bear.

title: Send the Queen's Guard
summary: Garran's soldiers ask questions that sound like orders.

effects.success_text: The Guard returns with a name.
effects.fail_text: The trail is cold, and louder for being walked.

title: Rally old veterans
summary: You ride with only a few loyal men. Others still straighten when your name is whispered. Find which of them will leave their captains.

title: Speak your name
summary: Stop being a hired sword. Become the king's brother again, accusation and all.

effects.text: Ethan Valen is no longer a rumour. He is on the road with his own face.

title: Visit a former regiment
summary: A company you once led is within a week's ride. Ask whether their oath was to Erol, or to the man they still measure other captains against.

title: Appeal in the market
summary: No feast. No seal. Just a man the villages used to feed.

title: Trace the royal payments
summary: Follow the money that raised you. Tomas will feel the footsteps.

title: Seek a witness to your birth
summary: The lodge is three hundred miles and twenty-four years away. Someone is still alive.

effects.fail_text: The lodge has been emptied of people who remember anything useful.

fail.text: The hunting lodge keeps its mouth shut.

title: Ask House Maren outright
summary: Tomas and Evelyne have been your parents. Today you ask them to be witnesses.

effects.text: You ask the only family you have whether they have been lying kindly.

title: Present the proofs
summary: Lay the letters, the payments, and the witness where a lord cannot pretend to be confused.

title: Demand submission
summary: Send terms. Call them peace. Mean the army behind them.

title: Call the northern levies
summary: More spears. More mouths. The Reach answers because it has been trained to.

title: Renew the marriage ultimatum
summary: Mira may crown you, or meet you on the road. You let her hear both sentences in the same letter.

title: Frighten a lesser lord
summary: A visit from Storm is rarely social.

title: Raid
summary: Strike a land you do not hold.

title: Spy
summary: Buy a look at a rival.

title: Envoy
summary: Visit a house.

title: Assassinate
summary: A knife instead of a war.

title: Fortify
summary: Spend coin on walls.

title: Occupy
summary: Take a land because you can.
